subject: SIG / SOC2 intake: Sentience Health RFP (control mapping & evidence delivery)
messages:
From: Anika Roy <anika.roy@sentiencehealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP 7892: Security questionnaire kickoff and SIG delivery

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor selection for the care-coordination feature, procurement has requested the completed SIG questionnaire, a SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 bridge if Type II is not available), and a control mapping showing how your controls satisfy our SIG/ISO asks. Our internal timeline is tight: we need materials in the next 5 business days to remain in scope for Q3.

Can you confirm availability and provide an initial intake packet (owners, expected delivery dates, and the primary contact for evidence uploads)? Also please indicate whether Redwood supports customer-managed key (BYO-KMS) options for private deployments — that will determine our legal/controls path.

RFP ref: SENT-RFP-7892
Procurement contact: procurement@sentiencehealth.com

Best,
Anika
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Sentience Health

Attachments: sentience-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
To: Anika Roy <anika.roy@sentiencehealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 7892: Security questionnaire kickoff and SIG delivery

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can meet the 5-business-day window for an initial packet (SIG crosswalk + SOC 2 evidence pointer).

Quick summary of commitments:
- SOC 2: we will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II 2027) by Friday 2028-06-29.
- SIG crosswalk: deliver a control mapping spreadsheet showing Redwood controls mapped to SIG and ISO 27001 control IDs, with columns for evidence filename and owner. Target 2028-06-30.
- BYO-KMS: supported on Redwood Private; I will include a short note on KMS/HSM integrations in the crosswalk.

Owners: Jasmine (audit packet & SOC 2), Neha (control crosswalk & artifact collection), Karthik (technical proofs: KMS, network segmentation, telemetry).

Can you confirm whether we should upload artifacts to your procurement SFTP or provide a secure Drive link? If you prefer DocuSign for the PO / confidentiality letter, send the envelope link and we’ll sign.

I’m including our SIG intro checklist to speed things up.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Assurance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-Intro-Checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Anika Roy <anika.roy@sentiencehealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sentiencehealth.com
Date: 2028-06-26T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 7892: Security questionnaire kickoff and SIG delivery

Sofia — perfect, thank you. Procurement prefers uploads to a dedicated Google Drive folder (we'll grant your team an upload link) and DocuSign for the confidentiality addendum. Our SFTP is restricted.

One clarification on the deliverables: we need the control-level evidence for these control families first: Access Control (AC), Encryption & Key Management (EKM), Logging & Monitoring (LM), and Change Management (CM). If you can prioritize those in the crosswalk with owner names and sample artifacts, that will satisfy our initial gating review.

Procurement has opened the DocuSign envelope (link below) for the mutual NDA and SOW attachment. Please sign to keep the RFP moving.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/SENT-ENV-4421
Drive: will follow by EOD with upload permissions.

Regards,
Anika

Attachment: sentience-intake-template.xlsx (they included a filled excel with required artifact names)

Adding an internal note and proposed sprint plan. Quoting Anika below for context:

> One clarification on the deliverables: we need the control-level evidence for these control families first: Access Control (AC), Encryption & Key Management (EKM), Logging & Monitoring (LM), and Change Management (CM).

Proposed assignments and deliverables:
- Jasmine: compile SOC 2 report + redacted logs package (LM). Deliverable: redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf, redwood-logs-sample.tar.gz (redaction notes). Due: 2028-06-29.
- Neha: SIG crosswalk spreadsheet; prioritize AC, EKM, CM columns with evidence file links & owners. Deliverable: sig-crosswalk-sentience.xlsx. Due: 2028-06-30.
- Karthik: technical proofs (KMS configuration notes + network segmentation diagrams). Deliverable: kms-and-segmentation.pdf. Due: 2028-06-30.

Action items:
1) Neha — create the crosswalk skeleton today and capture 'owner' and 'evidence filename' columns.
2) Jasmine — pull SOC 2 and prepare a redacted package (PII/tenant removal). Note: SOC 2 file will include a restricted appendix — we'll provide to the Sentience security contact under NDA only (use the DocuSign envelope).
3) Karthik — confirm BYO-KMS support matrix (cloud vendors + on-prem HSM) and include sample KMS policy.

I will collate artifacts and push to the Sentience Drive folder once DocuSign is signed. If we need legal to sign a specific redaction addendum, loop in Marissa for approvals.

— Jasmine
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: attestation-evidence-index.csv (small csv index for artifact tracking)
